faces.name: Wasteful Harvest
faces.oracle_text: Mill five cards. You may put a permanent card from among the cards milled this way into your hand. (To mill a card, put the top card of your library into your graveyard.)

static_abilities.raw_text: Mill five cards. You may put a permanent card from among the cards milled this way into your hand. (To mill a card, put the top card of your library into your graveyard.)

effects.text: You may put a permanent card from among the cards milled this way into your hand
